craft_notes: Sthāyin: telling-maṇḍala built. Rows: audience, ground, mandala, goddess. Read aloud: building tread.

lines: Where low-seated lovers of the matter, bridled in word and mind and limb, hear telling — it bears fruit.
First, on earth anointed with scent and the rest, trace or resolve:
a lotus-ground, four-square, three lotuses, midst-lotus throned the Speech-Queen, left and right the Host-Lord and guide — adore;
on the ground-lotus, the boon-goddess of the telling.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra nimnāsanasthitebhyaḥ tatparebhyo niyamitavāṅmanaḥkāyebhyo vyākhyā kriyamāṇā phalavatī bhavati prathamaṃ gandhādiliptāyāṃ bhuvi ullikhya saṃkalpya vā padmādhāraṃ caturaśraṃ padmatrayaṃ padmamadhye vāgīśīṃ vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ gaṇapatigurū ca pūjayet ādhārapadme vyākhyeyakalpadevatām
